texts.label: text
texts.orig: Credit ratings assigned by rating agencies to structured credit products have played an important role in the development of the structured credit market, which has been cast into the limelight by the recent credit crisis. This study aims at clarifying some misconceptions related to CDO ratings, their interpretation and their use.
texts.text: Credit ratings assigned by rating agencies to structured credit products have played an important role in the development of the structured credit market, which has been cast into the limelight by the recent credit crisis. This study aims at clarifying some misconceptions related to CDO ratings, their interpretation and their use.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: We first describe the rating approaches used by major agencies for CDOs and other structured credit products. Most rating agencies have been using static factor models which are slight variations on the Gaussian copula model allowing for intersector and intrasector correlations. texts.text: We first describe the rating approaches used by major agencies for CDOs and other structured credit products. Most rating agencies have been using static factor models which are slight variations on the Gaussian copula model allowing for intersector and intrasector correlations. Using this framework, we explore several issues related to CDO ratings. Our findings can be summarized as follows:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Given the leveraged nature of CDOs, the downgrade risk of a CDO tranche can be quite different from a bond with same initial rating. Therefore, a simple labeling via default probability or expected loss does not discriminate sufficiently their downgrade risk.
texts.text: Given the leveraged nature of CDOs, the downgrade risk of a CDO tranche can be quite different from a bond with same initial rating. Therefore, a simple labeling via default probability or expected loss does not discriminate sufficiently their downgrade risk.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · CDO tranche ratings require assumptions on the dependence structure of the default times and are thus exposed to model risk . We explore this model risk for CDO and CDO-squared tranches in a multisector factor model.
texts.text: CDO tranche ratings require assumptions on the dependence structure of the default times and are thus exposed to model risk . We explore this model risk for CDO and CDO-squared tranches in a multisector factor model.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The interaction between the rating threshold and the structuring procedure can cause new issues to have tranches structured 'at the limit' of rating categories and thus a high probability of downgrading.
texts.text: The interaction between the rating threshold and the structuring procedure can cause new issues to have tranches structured 'at the limit' of rating categories and thus a high probability of downgrading.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Migration probabilities for tranches with similar rating can vary from structure to structure even for the same underlying debt portfolio: two tranches with the same rating can have completely different transition probabilities.
texts.text: Migration probabilities for tranches with similar rating can vary from structure to structure even for the same underlying debt portfolio: two tranches with the same rating can have completely different transition probabilities.
